operators.easa: Air operators certified in EASA member states (EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway, Switzerland)
operators.tco: Third-country operators authorised by EASA, when flying to, from or within the EU

zones.name: Ukraine
zones.recommendation: Should not operate in FIRs Lviv, Kyiv, Dnipro, Simferopol and Odesa and UIR Kyiv at any altitude, including landings and departures.
zones.notes: Natural Earth places Crimea in Russia's polygon; its part is added because Crimea lies in FIR Simferopol. Over-sea parts of FIRs Odesa and Simferopol are not modelled.

zones.name: Belarus
zones.recommendation: Operations in FIR Minsk are prohibited by EASA Safety Directives (binding), as restated in CZIB-2022-01R14.
zones.notes: A Safety Directive rather than a bulletin; it has no expiry date. The revision date is that of the bulletin that restates it.

zones.name: Russia west of 60°E
zones.recommendation: Recommends not to operate in FIRs Moscow, Rostov-na-Donu, Sankt-Peterburg, Yekaterinburg and Samara west of 60°E at any altitude.
zones.notes: Kaliningrad (FIR Kaliningrad) and Crimea (FIR Simferopol, see ua) are excluded.

zones.name: Russia (closed to EU airlines)
zones.recommendation: Russia's Federal Air Transport Agency closed Russian airspace to airlines of EU states and others (special permission aside) in response to EU sanctions.
zones.notes: Not an EASA advisory: a state restriction that applies only to airlines of the listed states. EASA-authorised third-country airlines are not covered.

zones.name: Iran
zones.recommendation: Not operate within FIR Tehran at any altitude.
zones.notes: FIR Tehran's over-water parts of the Persian Gulf and Gulf of Oman are covered by gulf and oman.

zones.name: Iraq
zones.recommendation: Not operate within FIR Baghdad at any altitude.

zones.name: Lebanon
zones.recommendation: Not operate within FIR Beirut at any altitude, except Beirut (BEY) flights arriving or departing over the sea after a risk assessment.
zones.notes: Flights to or from Beirut start or end inside the zone and are reported as not guaranteed.

zones.name: Persian Gulf
zones.recommendation: Not operate over the waters of the Persian Gulf in FIRs Bahrain, Kuwait, Doha and Emirates at any altitude, except to arrive at or depart from their aerodromes. Exercise caution over their land.
zones.notes: The whole Natural Earth Persian Gulf polygon is used; its Iranian half is also in FIR Tehran. Flights to or from Bahrain, Kuwait, Qatar and the UAE are exempt.

zones.name: Gulf of Oman west of 58°E
zones.recommendation: Not operate over the waters of the Gulf of Oman in FIR Muscat west of 58°E at any altitude.

zones.name: Syria
zones.recommendation: Not operate west of the line ZELAF–BASEM–LOTAX–LATEB at any altitude; not below FL260 in the rest of FIR Damascus; exercise caution at and above FL260.
zones.notes: The bulletin gives no coordinates for its waypoints, so the whole of FIR Damascus is avoided: a conservative approximation.

zones.name: Sudan
zones.recommendation: Recommends not to fly within the airspace over Sudan (FIR Khartoum) at any altitude.

zones.name: Yemen
zones.recommendation: Not operate in FIR Sana'a at any altitude, except the maritime routes east of B400 (exercise caution).
zones.notes: Only Yemen's territory is modelled; the FIR's over-sea parts are not.

zones.name: Afghanistan
zones.recommendation: Not operate within FIR Kabul below FL320.
zones.notes: Applies only to flights too short to reach the modelled cruising level (FL360).

zones.name: Libya
zones.recommendation: Not operate within FIR Tripoli below FL320 (sea approaches to coastal airports excepted); exercise caution above FL320.
zones.notes: Applies only to flights too short to reach the modelled cruising level (FL360).

zones.name: Somalia
zones.recommendation: Not operate in the airspace of Somalia (FIR Mogadishu) at or below FL260.
zones.notes: Applies only to flights too short to reach the modelled cruising level (FL360).

zones.name: Mali
zones.recommendation: Not operate in FIRs Niamey and Dakar within the territory of Mali below FL260.
zones.notes: Applies only to flights too short to reach the modelled cruising level (FL360).

notModelled.name: Saudi Arabia (FIR Jeddah)
notModelled.reason: Its no-fly area is bounded by waypoints (RIBOK–…–SILPA and ULBAM–…–SOLAT) whose coordinates the bulletin does not publish; the rest of FIR Jeddah is caution only.

notModelled.name: Jordan (FIR Amman)
notModelled.reason: Caution only; no recommendation not to operate.

notModelled.name: Pakistan (Baluchistan and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa)
notModelled.reason: Below FL260 only, and the bundled data has no province boundaries.

notModelled.name: Land areas of FIRs Bahrain, Kuwait, Doha, Emirates and Muscat
notModelled.reason: Caution only; the over-water parts are modelled as gulf and oman.
